title: Reporting Minimalism Model — v2 Target Architecture
design_authority: S200 Agent G + S201 Agent G (Board 5 — Reporting Burden Analysis)
sources: S311-S320 session output inventory (83 distinct report types classified)
principles: Every report must have a single consumer board
No metric appears in more than 2 reports
Each report is consumable by its audience within 5 minutes
Reports are facts + decisions, not process narratives
One file per board — agent findings embedded, not persisted separately

report_1.name: Readiness Report
report_1.purpose: Pre-session and mid-session operational state. Answers: Is the session safe to start? Have all prerequisites been met? What is the current portfolio state? Is the session on track to complete?

when_generated.description: Generated at T0 before any write operations. Confirms all prerequisites are met.
Generated at Tmid (~30 min mark). Confirms session is on track, no drift detected.

report_consolidation_map.description: How current report categories from S311-S320 map to the 4-report v2 model

to_readiness_report.consolidation_action: Portfolio state section (R1_PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT). Session plan section (R1_SESSION_PLAN). All 10-15 metrics reduced to the 12 fields in R1 sections.
Domain E/F readiness in R1_SESSION_PLAN. Forecast data reduces to 'estimated_operations' + 'delta_from_last_session' fields.
Session gate status section (R1_SESSION_GATE). Go/No-Go decision + blocking conditions.
Portfolio snapshot (R1_PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT) + delta from last session (R1_SESSION_PLAN).
Target QIDs in scope (R1_SESSION_PLAN.target_qids). Domain E/F readiness includes seed enumeration.
Target QIDs in scope (R1_SESSION_PLAN) for certification waves. REMAINING_INVENTORY_UPDATE merges into delta.
Domain-specific data compressed into R1_SESSION_PLAN.domain_e_f_readiness. No standalone domain report.

SPLIT: portfolio-level certified counts → R1_PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT. Item-level impact → R2 per-item scores. But the standalone PORTFOLIO_IMPACT_ANALYSIS.json is retired — its content is distributed to R1 and R2.

to_quality_report.current_category: EW INTEGRITY AUDIT / EW AUDIT / EW COVERAGE AUDIT
to_quality_report.consolidation_action: Merged into R2_EW_INTEGRITY section. Structural defect inventory consolidated there instead of 3 separate files per session.
Merged into R2_CONTENT_QUALITY (technical_accuracy_pct, items_failing_technical). No standalone technical review file.

to_quality_report.current_category: QUALITY GATE RESULTS / AUDIT / CERTIFICATION / VERIFICATION
to_quality_report.consolidation_action: Content merged into appropriate R2 sections. EV compliance → R2_CONTENT_QUALITY.ev_compliance_breakdown. Structural findings → R2_STRUCTURAL_STATE. Per-item → R2_PER_ITEM_VERDICT.
SPLIT: structural defect inventory (DL-008/026/016) → R2_STRUCTURAL_STATE. Delivery pool exclusion → Report 4 (R4_PORTFOLIO_GATE). Content safety (DL-030) → R2_CONTENT_QUALITY.
Merged into a note field in R2_PER_ITEM_VERDICT (per-item rendering compliance flag). UIQS Validation was 95% unique scope — retained as sub-score, not standalone report.
Merged into R2_CONTENT_QUALITY.coso_citation_audit. Single field, not a standalone report.
SPLIT: defect counts → R2_STRUCTURAL_STATE. Defect library updates → Report 4 (R4_DEFECT_UPDATES).

to_quality_report.current_category: CLONE GROUP CLOSURE / CROSS PACK AUDIT
to_quality_report.consolidation_action: Clone group status → R2_STRUCTURAL_STATE (as a note on rotation-group items). Cross-pack consistency → R2_CONTENT_QUALITY (as a cross-reference integrity check).

to_certification_report.consolidation_action: Merged entirely into R3_CERTIFICATION_DECISIONS + R3_STATE_TRANSITIONS. This is the most natural merge — Certification Results is already the target report content.
Duplicate prevention verification → R3_EVIDENCE_PACKAGE (as one of the new_rules_enforced). No standalone file needed.
Promotion results → R3_STATE_TRANSITIONS (from In Audit → Certified). Insertion package → R3_EVIDENCE_PACKAGE.

to_governance_report.consolidation_action: Merged into R4_SESSION_CLOSE (hash verification, backup protocol, no unexpected drift). Also R4_GOVERNANCE_EVENTS (critical incidents).

REPLACED by Report 4 (Governance & Audit Report). The MD narrative format is retained; Report 4 is the session summary. Report 4 adds structured governance fields while preserving the executive narrative. The old SESSION_SUMMARY.md is retired — Report 4 IS the session summary.
Portfolio risk register → R4_PORTFOLIO_GATE.portfolio_risk_register. Not a standalone report.
Merged into R4_SESSION_CLOSE (tend hash verification, backup protocol). Ledger sync is covered by Registry cross-reference in R4.

retires.current_category: AUTHORING BATCH, AUTHORING QUALITY GATE, AUTHORING SPEC
retires.rationale: One-off batch authoring plans. Content: item specifications and batch manifests. Retire because: consumed only within authoring session, content embedded in REVISION_HISTORY.md entry for traceability, authoring plan parameters subset of Report 1 SESSION_PLAN.

One-off domain design documents. Retire because: consumed only within design session. Domain scope parameters captured in S311 EW Factory standard for reusability. Individual session specs are too granular for permanent retention.
One-off coverage analysis. Retire because: domain distribution covered by Report 1 (R1_PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT). Re-runnable as an automated scan from Registry data.

retires.current_category: EXECUTION ROADMAP / PRIORITY UPDATE / CAPACITY ANALYSIS / PLANNING PACKAGE
retires.rationale: One-off planning artifacts. Retire because: consumed only within planning session. Session plan now lives in Report 1. Roadmap decisions documented in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
One-off simulation and validation outputs. Retire because: re-runnable from automated scan. Structural scan results now in Report 2.
One-off remediation tracking files. Retire because: remediation progress tracked per-item in Report 2 (R2_PER_ITEM_VERDICT). Before/after enrichment documentation in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
Batch-specific artifacts. Retire because: wave scope is Report 1 target_qids. Wave quality audit is Report 2. Wave extraction baselines are one-off batch artifacts — retire after batch close.
One-off delta report. Retire because: remaining inventory is a Registry Board computation, captured in Report 1 delta_from_last_session.

metric_deduplication.description: In v1, the core 15 metrics appeared across an average of 5.3 files per session. The certified count alone appeared in 7-8 files per session. Below is the v2 assignment: each metric appears in at most 2 reports.

certified_item_count.rationale: Report 1 owns the authoritative snapshot. Report 3 reports certification delta. No other report stores certified count.

ew_integrity_metrics.rationale: Report 2 owns EW fill rate, boilerplate rate, choice specificity. Report 4 references aggregate health, not per-slot detail.

defect_counts_by_class.rationale: Report 2 owns the live structural defect inventory. Report 4 tracks changes to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md (new discoveries, resolutions).

domain_distribution.rationale: Domain certification distribution is a Readiness concern. Quality and Certification consume it from Report 1.

session_duration_agent_utilization.primary_report: Report 1 (Readiness — R1_MID_SESSION at Tmid; final in R4_SESSION_CLOSE)
session_duration_agent_utilization.rationale: Agent deployment is tracked during session in Report 1 and finalized in Report 4.

governance_guard_status.rationale: Guard status is a pre-session gate check (Report 1) with a post-session attestation (Report 4).

portfolio_health_index.rationale: Portfolio health is a governance concern. Report 4 owns it. Readiness references it but does not duplicate.

certification_results_per_qid.rationale: Certification decisions per QID belong exclusively in Report 3.

total_item_count.rationale: 2,900 is a constant. It changes only when QIDs are added or removed (extremely rare). Report 1 stores it.

revision_history_entry_data.secondary_report: Report 4 (Governance — R4_REVISION_APPENDIX validates and confirms write)
revision_history_entry_data.v1_redundancy: Written independently by Certification and Governance agents
revision_history_entry_data.rationale: Certification prepares the entry content. Governance validates it and confirms the write to REVISION_HISTORY.md.

section_certification_percentage.rationale: Section-level certification is a derivative of domain distribution. Computed from Report 1 data.

delta_ledger_differences.rationale: What changed since last session is a readiness concern. Consumed by all boards from Report 1.

difficulty_and_blooms_distribution.rationale: Difficulty calibration and Bloom's distribution are quality metrics. Report 2 owns them.

risk_register.rationale: Risk tracking is a governance function. Report 4 owns the live risk register snapshot.

soft_cap_enforcement.soft_cap_rule: Sessions producing > 8 files in the reports/ directory require a BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker in the session's Report 4 (R4_REPORTING_COMPLIANCE) with explicit justification.

phase_down_schedule.target: Soft cap active at 8. Current average: 11.7. Phase 1 infrastructure may produce extra files (registry snapshots, delta ledger bootstrap).
Soft cap enforced at 8. Phase 2 board consolidation reduces natural file count. Expect average 5-7.
Hard cap at 4. Only the 4 reports + potentially 1-2 emergency/edge-case files with BLOCK-AUTHORIZED.

files_exempt_from_cap: Backup files (pack_*.js.bak-*) — protocol files, not reports
MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md — auto-generated per Rule 3, in knowledge/ not reports/
Validator output files — in scripts/ not reports/
Test suite output — in scripts/ not reports/
Agent debug logs — temporary files in Temp/ not reports/
soft_cap_enforcement.cap_scope: Only files written to reports/ directory count toward the cap.

retirement_plan.description: How legacy reports are retired without deletion. Per AGENTS.md: no data loss, archive-only.

archival_strategy.method: Move, not delete. Legacy files moved to reports/legacy/ subdirectory organized by session series.
archival_strategy.index: reports/legacy/LEGACY_INDEX.md — maps legacy file names to session, content summary, date. Auto-generated from file metadata.

retire_to_legacy: All SESSION-prefixed files from sessions pre-S830 that are NOT in the keep_active list
All systematic_testing/ session export files (pilot data, 17 synthetic student files)
All agent-specific output files (SESSION301_AGENT_*.json through SESSION809_AGENT_*.json)
All duplicate dashboard variants (domain-specific dashboards from S310)
All WAVE*-specific and BATCH*-specific files after wave close
All individual execution/validation report pairs (S17-*_EXECUTION.md + S17-*_VALIDATION.md)

retirement_plan.timing: Archival executes at S830 Phase 1 activation. Pre-S830 reports are moved to legacy/ in a single governed batch operation with BEFORE/AFTER file counts documented in REVISION_HISTORY.md.
